dedupe_keys.name: life safety model lsm agent based model of loss of life and evacuation in floods and dam breaks hr wallingford

description: The Life Safety Model (LSM), sold by HR Wallingford, is an agent-based model that simulates how people, vehicles and buildings in a floodplain interact with a flood wave, to estimate how many people are likely to be injured or killed and how long evacuation takes, for flood and dam-break emergency plans. Unlike simple empirical equations for screening, it simulates each person, building and vehicle with physically based representations of the stability of people and vehicles and the strength of buildings in floodwater, so that the effect of better warnings and evacuation routes can be tested. It takes flood outputs from commercial two-dimensional hydrodynamic models such as Telemac-2D, TUFLOW and MIKE 21 and couples them with the simulator in a GIS environment. Coverage: generic. Format and access: commercial software and consultancy from HR Wallingford; contact for access. Licence: proprietary; terms and prices were not read. Caveats: only the product page was read; validation studies and input formats were not checked. Simulation uses: loss-of-life and evacuation time estimates for emergency planning below dams and in flood-prone towns, including the effect of road routes and warning times. Related records: openTELEMAC-MASCARET (model-telemac-mascaret) can supply the flood inputs, and HR Wallingford's EMBREA breach model (model-hr-wallingford-embrea-dam-embankment-breach) supplies breach outflows.
